definition: buying an ebook as a licence bound to an account rather than as a thing I hold

settled:
A Kindle book is locked to my Amazon account, so it is not really mine. What I bought was a licence.

Amazon keeps the legal power to take a book I paid for back off my device. It is rare and it has happened.

Audible adds a turn of the screw. Stop the subscription and the library goes with it, which a bought ebook at least does not do.

Amazon itself is a D before any of this: how it treats the people in its warehouses, how it behaves toward competitors, and where its owner has moved politically.

title: What I Do Not Own When I Buy A Book
